C1191.title: Alibaba Cloud Container Service and Security Center Named CAICT Cloud-Native Security Benchmark Case
C1191.summary: In January 2025, a joint solution from Alibaba Cloud Container Service and Cloud Security Center was recognized as a “Cloud-Native Security Benchmark Case” by the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT). The solution focuses on building an integrated cloud-native runtime protection system to address runtime threats such as container escape and image vulnerabilities.
